review_basis: All20 exact reconciled hinted values freshly read against source and already-inspected realcallers. Explicit reconciliation disagreements re-evaluated rather than inferred resolved. No carry or whole-maincatalog fresh-reading claim. Corrections after this exact candidate require affected-key fresh recheck.
linguistic_verdict: Source-faithful coherent StandardThai; agent-reviewed, not native-human certification. Native hints safe by actual reading plus combining-mark/preposed-vowel/placeholder guard.
boundary_checks: No leading/trailing/repeated marker; no marker before Thai dependent vowels/tone marks or after preposed vowels; no changed placeholder tokens. Manual lexical reading is separate from these mechanical guards.
